Benefits Of Working With Mobilunity

High-Quality Hiring

Using a talent pool of 1000+ pre-vetted experts and our extensive recruitment team, we make a perfect fit to your needs. Running thorough research, we discover and bring you the best talents on the market. After hire, we continue to support your new employees, ensuring they thrive within your team right from day 1.

Flexible Cooperation

Serving different industry sectors and organizations of different size and capacity, our software engineers provide diverse skill sets and flexibility. You can hire an individual expert full-time, build a whole dedicated team, or engage a part-time developer to gain fresh insights and give a spur to your project delivery.

Strategic Approach

Having most of our software engineers work with us for 3.5 years on average, we are committed to the 3R Model: strong Relationships, fast & quality Recruitment, and high Retention. We are aimed at a strategic partnership that makes a difference.

Expertise Beyond .NET Dev

Having worked for 14+ years in a highly competitive environment, we have now become a global provider of technical and non-technical talent solutions. On request, we can supply you with hard-to-find software engineers, rare senior-level executives, or development experts with a custom tech stack.

Domain Experience

Staying at the forefront of rapidly developing industries, such as finances, banking, Supply Chain Management, and ERP, we highlight adaptation to innovations. We can help you meet evolving business needs, effectively implementing new trends like AI/ML, advanced DevOps, and cloud services.

Talent Retention

Prioritizing team performance and well-being of every developer we hire, we go far beyond traditional staffing. We provide a full scope of HR support for your new employees: custom onboarding, performance reviews, benefit packages, wellness monitoring, and assistance with sensitive discussions.

How To Hire .NET Developers With Mobilunity

{01}

Request

Tell us about your requirements, the number of developers, level of seniority, budget expectations, and the key skills you’re looking for. Choose your cooperation model – hiring dedicated .NET developer(s) full-time or engaging part-time FLEX experts.

{02}

Interviewing

We complete preliminary scanning and prepare a shortlist of hand-picked candidates tailored to the needs of your project. You choose the .NET specialists you’re most interested in, then we are going to run a series of interviews involving you too.

{03}

Onboarding

Once all data security, intellectual property protection documents, and hiring contracts are signed, we’re going to proceed with the onboarding. Our account managers will help you set clear communication with new team members.

{04}

Support & Retention

After allocating your .NET developers, our HR team keeps working to support your external staff with the full scope of related activities: benefit packages, performance excellence, wellness monitoring, and all necessary assistance.

.NET Development Services That Developers Can Provide

Web .NET App Development

Hire .NET developers to help your team build secure, scalable, and performing web apps. Our software engineers use ASP.NET, .NET Core, and MVC dot net frameworks to create feature-rich dot net solutions tailored to unique needs and the ever-evolving requirements of business.

Custom .NET Development

Engage expert programmers, who understand your business. Whether your dot net project is a web portal, innovative mobile app, or comprehensive enterprise-level system, we have expert developers who can help you create feature-rich dot net development solutions aligned with your commercial objectives.

.NET Migration Services

Software developers from us can help you elevate performance, modernize outdated systems, minimize downtime, boost operational efficiency, and future-proof your dot net applications. We can help you analyze your system, identify dependencies and risks, and spot best migration opportunities.

.NET Integration Services

Use our professional expertise in API integration, data migration, cloud integration, and connecting legacy systems to new .NET applications. We will assess your current infrastructure and help you create a custom integration roadmap tailored to your business requirements, internal and customer needs.

Enterprise .NET Development

Hire our dedicated .NET development specialists to help you build high-performance, reliable enterprise-grade solutions that drive business growth. With a focus on scalability, our experts will help your project handle high user volumes and large amounts of data, ensuring a smooth experience during peak loads.

Mobile App .NET Development

Choose top dedicated developers to create feature-rich mobile apps tailored to your business needs. Whether it’s a customer-faced product, an employee productivity tool, or an enterprise solution, our remote dot net developers ensure a seamless experience and high performance across all devices and platforms.

IoT and Embedded Systems

From industrial automation to smart home solutions, engage .NET developers to build custom, high-performance IoT systems and embedded solutions. We focus on rapid prototyping and testing, backed with ongoing monitoring that supports optimal delivery and scalability of your project.

.NET Maintenance and Support

Engage our .NET specialists to ensure your applications are fast, secure, and fully functional. From bug fixes and troubleshooting to performance optimization, regular security checks, and meeting compliance requirements – we can help you act proactively, fixing issues before they impact your operations.

.Net Microservices and Docker Containerization Deployment

Hire .NET programmers who can handle every aspect of architecture, containerization, and monitoring to give you full visibility and control over your app’s performance. We will help you enhance resilience, allowing for easy deployment and scaling, resource optimization, and streamlining DevOps processes.

Frequently Asked Questions

How to find a reliable company offering remote net programmers for hire?

If you are looking to hire expert dot net developers, first pay attention to the capacity of your shortlisted vendors, ensure they have a vast talent network so that the hiring process would not take months. Consider checking the reputation of service providers, consider looking through client reviews on platforms like Clutch and Google, rankings, and industry awards. Also, look for case studies and success stories from clients that would demonstrate a proven track record, and focus on specific niche expertise and tech skills relevant to your project.

Do you provide support and maintenance services after deployment?

Yes, we do. Full commitment to your project’s success allows developers from Mobilunity to help you with ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and any assistance after deployment. Eventually, our dedicated dot net developers work with NET apps that are compatible with the latest releases, keeping them up-to-date with new features and improved performance.

What if I am not satisfied with the hired .Net developer’s work and would like to exit?

Should you face dissatisfaction with performance or have any concerns – you are free to contact us and exit at any moment. Or you may simply want to replace an employee – our recruitment experts will help you engage a new dotnet expert, paying double attention to your project demands and expectations and closing your request successfully with maximum satisfaction.

Do you provide NDA and IP protection for my project?

Yes, we do. Understanding the importance of confidentiality and intellectual property (IP) protection for your project, we provide Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) to ensure that all sensitive information and details about your project remain secure and confidential. Our commitment to transparency, security, and trust ensures that your development processes, workflows, and ideas are safe with us from start to finish.

How do you manage different time zones?

This will not be a problem. We work with a vast multi-million global talent pool, so we can provide you with top-notch talents with geographical proximity or overlapping time zones. Our developers are used to working with different PM and communication tools, such as GitHub, Trello, and Slack. They also rely on iterative SCRUM-based development and Agile approach to minimize communication gaps. Additionally, we can hire remote developers from nearshore locations – so that you can completely forget about any time zone differences.

How much does it cost to engage .NET developers for hire?

Prioritizing simple and transparent pricing, Mobilunity has several hiring models. Hiring dedicated net developers with us, you get the best price of quality. Tell us about your dot net project needs and development team extension requirements – schedule a consultation – and we will come back shortly to give you tailored options and cost estimates.

Can I get support for the technical interview with dot NET programmers?

Sure, you can. Not only our full-stack developers are skilled. Our expert interviewers are doing their best to make the process of recruitment maximum controllable and easy for our clients. Even if they lack specific knowledge or simply don’t have much time. Once you fill a request, we immediately scan our talent pool and run extensive market research – to come up with the best potentially matching candidates. During the interviewing process, we provide you with a full scope of assistance and engage our top tech interviewers to help you make informed decisions.

Can I hire a .NET developer for a short-term development project?

Yes, you can. We offer flexible options to cover your project needs at their best. Choose between hiring a full-time expert for the expected project duration, or engaging a software developer via a time-based approach. Later on, when you see that our developers are proficient – you may want to extend the project duration, or engage your top remote experts for other activities in the future. And we can take care of their retention.

What are the other competencies of your .NET programmers?

Apart from dot NET web development, mobile and custom applications, integration and migration, dot NET developers for hire can boost your team with other specialized expertise and popular net technologies. For example, for startups and enterprises, .NET optimisation, .NET on docker containerization, dot NET application development, and maintenance.

Do you provide full cycle dot NET development services?

Mobilunity isn’t a dot NET development company. We focus on assisting businesses in recruiting dedicated .NET developers customized to their unique requirements. If you need help with front-end, back-end, or full-stack development, we link you to proficient experts who can manage all phases of the software development lifecycle. Our developers can effortlessly join your team, guaranteeing that your business objectives are achieved efficiently and effectively.
